requirements: R1: Each locker compartment starts in the Empty state with the door closed.
R2: When an authenticated courier deposits a package with a valid deposit code while the compartment is Empty, the system locks the package inside and moves to OccupiedAwaitingPickup.
R3: When the recipient enters the correct pickup code while in OccupiedAwaitingPickup, the system unlocks the compartment door and moves to DoorOpen.
R4: When the compartment door is closed after recipient removal while in DoorOpen, the system returns to Empty.
R5: When an incorrect pickup code is entered while in OccupiedAwaitingPickup and fewer than five consecutive failures have occurred, the system denies access and remains in OccupiedAwaitingPickup.
R6: When five consecutive incorrect pickup codes are entered while in OccupiedAwaitingPickup, the system moves to LockedOut temporarily and denies further code entry.
R7: When the lockout timer expires while in LockedOut, the system returns to OccupiedAwaitingPickup.
R8: When the maximum collection period expires without pickup while in OccupiedAwaitingPickup, the system moves to ExpiredAwaitingReturn.
R9: When an authenticated courier retrieves an expired parcel while in ExpiredAwaitingReturn, the system returns to Empty.
R10: When an oversized package is detected during deposit while Empty, the system rejects the deposit and remains in Empty.
R11: The system must not open the compartment for pickup unless the correct pickup code is entered in OccupiedAwaitingPickup.
R12: The system must not accept courier deposit unless the courier is authenticated and the compartment is Empty.
